title: Deal Pricing
description: CPM pricing for SSP deals. SSP deals are always CPM-based: floor_price for curated/PMP deals (auction-based), fixed_price for programmatic guaranteed or preferred deals. At least one of floor_price or fixed_price should be provided.

pricing_model.description: Always 'cpm' for SSP deals. CPC/CPA are not native SSP deal constructs.

floor_price.description: Minimum CPM for auction-based deals (curated, PMP). Buyers bid above this floor; clearing price determined by first-price auction.

fixed_price.description: Exact CPM for guaranteed or preferred deals. Buyer pays this rate regardless of bid value.
